_comment: Accuracy thresholds for live_eval regression gate. Apply to pytest -m live_eval runs only.
_design_note: These thresholds apply to the 6-fixture regression gate only. Production accuracy must be validated against a broader document set spanning diverse companies, sectors, and report formats. Fixture expected values must be source-verified from PDFs — never adjusted to match model output. Model consensus (multiple models agreeing) does not prove correctness; ground truth is the source document.
